name: logo-strip
title: Logo strip
description: Scrolling customer logos with hover pause and an optional rotating quote.
usage: Customer logos right under the hero. The label's key phrase in blue; logos as image sources or nodes, each with an optional `quote` (a testimonial) and case study link; set `compact` on a wide, short mark (the site's Zero) so it sits smaller. `edgePattern` fills the gutters beside the column with the hero's dot field.
avoid: Logos in full color at rest
Color on hover for white artwork (set `whiteArtwork`)
A loop that runs under reduced motion

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
